civilopediaText.text:
Welcome to Cultural Starting Bonuses!

In this mod, every civ (if the mod has support for it) has a starting bonus based on their cultures! And down below is what bonus each culture group gives.
African Cultures:

Central African:
Starts with [Mining] already researched.

East African:
Free [Stone Works] in Capital after discovering [Masonry].

Khoisan:
Starting units have [Scouting I].

Nile:
Starts with [Masonry] already researched.

Southern African:
Starts with 1 [Spearman], and starting units gain +10 XP.

West African:
Starts with [Bronze Working] already researched.
Asian Cultures:

Anatolian:
May choose 1 additional Pantheon belief after founding a Religion.

East Asian:
Starts with 1 [Worker].

Himalayan:
Starts with [Shrine] in Capital.

Indian:
1 free [Incense] after discovering [Calendar].

Iranic:
Starts with [The Wheel] already researched.

Japanese:
Starts with 1 Artist in Capital.

Levantine:
Starting units have +1 Movement and +1 Sight.

Mesopotamian:
Starts with [Writing] already researched.

Middle Eastern:
Starts with [Animal Husbandry] already researched.

Southeast Asian:
Reveals a nearby City-State upon building a [Shrine].

Steppe:
2 free [Horses] after discovering [Animal Husbandry].
European Cultures:

Baltic:
[Great Prophet] appears in Capital with 1 to 6 neighboring [Forest] tiles upon building a [Shrine].

British:
Starts with a sum of [Gold].

Celtic:
Starts with 1 [Warrior].

French:
Starts with a sum of [Culture].

Iberian:
Free [Swordsman] appears in Capital upom discovering [Iron Working], and starts with [Walls] in the Capital.

Germanic:
Starts with [Granary] in the Capital.

Steppe:
1 free [Wine] after discovering [Calendar].

Nordic:
Starting units have [Amphibious].

Slavic:
Starts with [Walls] and [Barracks] in the Capital.
North & South American Cultures:

Amazonian:
Starts with [Pottery] already researched.

Andean:
1 free [Gold Ore] after discovering [Mining].

Anglo-American:
Starts with 1 [Settler].

Aridoamerican:
Reveals 5 nearby [Bonus Resources].

Caribbean:
Free [Trireme] appears in Capital if settled by [Coast].

Latin American:
Starts with 1 [Population] in Capital.

Pacific Northwest:
Starts with [Sailing] already researched.

Mesoamerican:
Starts with [Calendar] already researched.

Oasisamerican:
Free [Aqueduct] in Capital after discovering [Engineering].

Patagonian:
Starts with 1 [Archer].

Plains:
Starts with [Trapping] already researched.

Polar:
Starts with [Archery] already researched.

Woodlands:
Starting units have [Woodsman].
Oceanic Cultures:

Aboriginal:
Starts with 1 [Scout], and reveals 1 nearby Natural Wonder.

Melanesian:
Starts with [Monument] in the Capital.

Oceanic:
Starting units can enter [Ocean] tiles.
Other Cultures:

Crusader:
Free [Knight] appears in Capital upon discovering [Chivalry].

Pirate:
Free [Privateer] appears in Capital if settled by [Coast] upon discovering [Navigation].
